metadata.description: Pedro's personal marketplace of Claude Code plugins: commands, skills, agents, hooks and MCP servers.

plugins.name: starter-kit
plugins.description: Baseline setup installed in every project so Claude behaves consistently: shared agents (code-explorer, archify-documenter), GitHub Spec Kit setup, the Impeccable design plugin, skills and commands.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Impeccable by Paul Bakaus (Apache-2.0): frontend design skill, commands and anti-pattern detection. Re-listed here, pinned to its 4.5.0 release, so starter-kit can depend on it.
